Title: Generally Available: Templates Support in Azure Logic Apps Standard

Body.Content:
We’re thrilled to announce the general availability of Templates Support in Azure Logic Apps Standard. 

Templates in Azure Logic Apps are pre-built workflow solutions designed to address a variety of integration scenarios, ranging from simple data transfers to complex automations and event-driven processes. These templates provide a robust starting point, enabling users to quickly set up and deploy workflows without having to build from scratch. 

With templates, developers can tap into a growing library of pre-built templates to jumpstart their Logic Apps projects. Whether you’re working on straightforward workflows or intricate integrations, these templates are designed to make it easier than ever to build, deploy, and manage your applications. 

To explore the new templates, open the Logic Apps Designer and browse the available options. Each template comes with detailed information, including a read-only view of the workflow, prerequisites, and connectors used. This allows you to quickly assess whether a template fits your needs before customizing it further to suit your specific business requirements. For step-by-step guidance, be sure to check out our updated documentation. 

Start building faster and more efficiently today with Templates in Azure Logic Apps Standard! Read more here.
